podcast.title: Dispute with Stone Roses
podcast.body: The Stone Roses faced significant issues with Silvertone Records around the early 1990s, which rendered them unable to release new music. "the roses had gotten to their whole silver tone thing and they were unable to get anything together."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Oral History of Manchester Part 2

podcast.title: The Stone Roses' Issues
podcast.body: The Stone Roses faced significant problems with Silvertone, which led to their inability to release new music for a period during the decline of the Madchester scene. "by this time the roses had gotten to their whole silver tone thing and they were unable to get anything together."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
